The '''Imperial ambunaut''' was an [[ambulance]] [[speeder]] used by the [[Galactic Empire]] to smoothly transport medical patients.<ref name="DB" /> In [[1 BBY]], [[Axis network|Axis]] leader [[Luthen Rael]] was taken to the [[Lina Soh Hospital]] on board one such [[transport]], after the [[Raid on the Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest|raid]] on his [[Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest|gallery]] resulted in him attempting [[Death|suicide]].<ref name="MIS" />

==Characteristics==
Appearing similar to many similar small transports, Imperial ambunauts were [[Ambulance|emergency]] medspeeders equipped with stabilizing technology that allowed for a smooth ride as well as a piercing siren loud enough to cut through the cacophony of [[Coruscant]] traffic.<ref name="DB" />

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial ambernaut first appeared in "[[Make It Stop]]," the tenth episode of the live-action [[Disney+]] series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor''{{'s}}]] [[Andor Season 2|second season]].<ref name="MIS" /> It was later identified in its [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] entry.<ref name="DB" /> The ambulance was a revamp of ''Andor'' [[Andor Season 1|season one's]] [[Pre-Mor Authority Security Forces|Pre-Mor security service's]] [[RK-392 mobile tac-pod|Mobile Tac-Pod vehicle]].<ref name="Secrets">{{SW|url=news/andor-trivia-guide-week-4|text=Secrets from the Set of ''Andor'' Season 2: Week 4 Trivia}}</ref>
